purpose: Define a conservative pre-data bridge from an explicit synthetic observation to PolicyInput without inferring authorization, validation, provenance, or outcomes.
rules: Exactly one known terminal event and FRESH freshness are required before terminal or blocked action flags can be set.
task.completed maps to terminal=true; non-completion terminal kinds map to blocked=true.
STALE, FUTURE_SKEW, INCONCLUSIVE, missing terminal, multiple terminals, or source-order ambiguity map to uncertain=true and required_predicate_inconclusive=true.
Authorization, validation, and provenance are passed only as explicit tri-state observations; no event label infers them.
Invalid or incomplete observations fail closed before PolicyInput construction.
non_effects: Does not generate or retain a Stage-A outcome.
Does not accept a source driver or runtime lock.
Does not establish efficacy, external validation, or High-Assurance.
